notes.title: [Offline Event] Luna Hop to Exhibit at PlayX4
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45456471/9f633684d617b297eb29581f9a4145876ff3361a.png[/img]

Hello from the Luna Hop team! 

We’re excited to announce that Luna Hop will be exhibiting at PlayX4 2025, 
held from May 22 (Thu) to May 25 (Sun) at KINTEX (Halls 3–5) in Ilsan!

Come visit our booth to experience Luna Hop firsthand and take part in our mini-events—with small gifts waiting for you! 

And there's more!
Luna Hop has been selected as one of the TOP 10 finalists in the 20th Gyeonggi Game Audition, and we’ll be on the final stage on Saturday, May 24 at 1:50 PM. Your cheers and support would mean the world to us! 🎉

📍 Event Info
・Dates: May 22 (Thu) – May 25 (Sun) / 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
・Venue: KINTEX Exhibition Center 1 (Halls 3, 4, 5), Ilsan
・Luna Hop B2B Booth: Hall 5 – G24 (Areumdamda)
・Luna Hop B2C Booth: Gyeonggi Game Audition Zone – C14

We look forward to meeting you in person at the event.
We’ll continue working hard to share an even better version of Luna Hop with you all.

Thank you as always!
– the Luna Hop Team 🐰

notes.title: [Offline Event] Luna Hop to Join ZEMPIE MEETUP
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45456471/367214debfa236157e4140d21d95777a37aea8e6.png[/img]
[b][h2]

[b][h2]Luna Hop is joining the ZEMPIE MEETUP! 🎉[/h2][/b]

📍 Date & Time: April 29th (Tue), 6:30 PM
📍 Location: AWS Korea, 18F Centerfield EAST, Yeoksam Station, Seoul

Come and experience Luna Hop at the meetup! 🎮
You'll also get a chance to meet and connect with a variety of indie game developers.

Our development team will be on site as well.
Feel free to stop by, play the game, and share your thoughts or questions with us! 🙌

notes.title: [Offline Event] Luna Hop at Illustar Festa 7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45456471/197714f0e1ff7b6891d2d257cf717ae9879612df.png[/img]

Hello from the Luna Hop team!
We’re excited to share some cheerful spring news with you.

[b]Luna Hop will be participating in the Illustar Festa 7 Indie Game Showcase[/b]
held at KINTEX Exhibition Center 1 (Halls 4 & 5) in Ilsan, Korea,
from May 3 (Sat) to May 4 (Sun), 2025.

At the event, you'll be able to play Luna Hop in person
and enjoy exclusive on-site events prepared just for the showcase.

📍 Event Dates: May 3 (Sat) – May 4 (Sun), 2025
📍 Hours: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
📍 Booth: IDG 20 (to the left of the main entrance)

We hope to meet many of you in person at the event
and will continue to share exciting updates as we move forward in development.

Thank you always for your support!
– Team Luna Hop
